subject: Two-factor sign-in is off
preheader: You can turn it back on from your account page.
footer_note: You're getting this because you have a VF Tech account. Account emails like this one can't be turned off.
body: Two-factor sign-in is now off for your VFTech account. You can turn it back on from your account page at any time.
If this wasn't you, reply to this email or use the Can't sign in? page straight away.
